prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1377; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the initial loss report for the left-turn collision at the intersection. Insured states they were turning left on a green arrow when the other vehicle proceeded straight through from the opposing lane. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles received from the insured and are in the file.

Entry 2: Spoke with the other driver's carrier. Liability is disputed; their insured maintains the light had turned yellow before they entered the intersection. Requested intersection signal timing records from the municipality and a copy of any traffic camera footage that may exist.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Attorney's office confirmed representation and asked that all communication go through them. Letter of representation logged. Claimant reports left shoulder pain following the impact and is scheduled for an orthopedic evaluation. Medical authorization requested through counsel.

Entry 4: Received medical records from the claimant's treating provider. Diagnosis indicates a shoulder injury with limited range of motion; imaging and physical therapy recommended. Reviewed records against the reported mechanism of injury. Consistent with the collision described. Referred file for injury valuation review.

Entry 5: Follow-up with claimant's counsel regarding outstanding treatment records and wage documentation. Counsel indicated a demand package will follow once treatment is complete. Liability position unchanged pending receipt of signal timing data and the police report. Diary set for next review.
